links.comparator_used: Conventional GPT-4o (described as capable of retrieval-augmented generation) without the customized BM25 document retrieval
links.outcome: Number of correctly answered clinical questions (15-question Korean gastroenterology benchmark)
links.effect: Customized GPT with BM25 retrieval over textbooks answered 8/15 correctly (10/15 after English terminology replacement); conventional GPT-4o scored 14/15; fellow 10/15; expert 15/15
links.tradeoff: Judgment-based questions remained a challenge for the customized model; performance depended on Korean vs English terminology in the retrieved documents/questions
links.quote: Conventional GPT-4o achieved the highest score among the AI models (14/15).

links.comparator_used: Customized GPT without Chain of Thought prompting
links.effect: No improved reasoning with Chain of Thought prompting; no numbers reported
links.quote: Even with the implementation of 'Chain of Thought' prompt engineering, the customized GPT did not achieve improved reasoning.
